name: write_triplet_then_dispatch
description: Stores three 16-bit values from data registers into consecutive words of a buffer located by an offset in the parameter block, then calls the routine selected by a second parameter word.

name: dispatch_table_entry_at_offset
description: Reads a 16-bit index from byte offset two of the parameter block and calls the routine at that index in the table of routine offsets relative to this code.

name: dispatch_table_entry_at_offset
description: Reads a 16-bit index from byte offset two of the parameter block and calls the routine at that index in the table of routine offsets relative to this code.

name: dispatch_table_entry_at_offset
description: Reads a 16-bit index from byte offset two of the parameter block and calls the routine at that index in the table of routine offsets relative to this code.

name: dispatch_table_entry_from_word
description: Uses the first 16-bit word of the parameter block directly as the index into the table of routine offsets and calls that entry.

name: dispatch_table_entry_at_offset
description: Reads a 16-bit index from byte offset two of the parameter block and calls the routine at that index in the table of routine offsets; many callers reference this entry point.

name: dispatch_table_entry_at_offset
description: Reads a 16-bit index from byte offset two of the parameter block and calls the routine at that index in the table of routine offsets relative to this code.

name: dispatch_chained_table_entry
description: Follows a 16-bit displacement stored in the parameter block to a second word, uses that word as the table index, and calls the routine at that entry.

name: call_two_table_entries
description: Calls the routine selected by the word the parameter pointer refers to, then calls the routine selected by the second word of the same parameter block.

name: store_word_and_dispatch
description: Copies a 16-bit value from the parameter block into a global variable, then calls the routine selected by the following word as a table index.

name: select_entry_by_flag_sign
description: Tests the sign of a flag byte found through a parameter-block pointer and a global variable. A negative flag calls the entry given by the block's second word; otherwise it calls the entry given by the long word at offset two.

name: select_entry_by_inverted_flag
description: Works like its neighbour with the branches swapped: a negative flag byte calls the entry from the long word at offset two, and a non-negative flag calls the entry given by the block's second word.

name: store_constant_and_dispatch
description: Stores the constant 107 in a global variable, then calls the routine selected by the first word of the parameter block.

name: shift_and_store_triplets
description: Calls a routine once per iteration and writes three 16-bit values, shifted right by a global count, into records twelve bytes apart. The loop count comes from the parameter block, and the routine ends by calling the entry named by a trailing word.

name: project_records_by_division
description: Walks a list of twelve-byte records and adds three global offsets to each record's first three words. When the third sum is below 63 it divides the first two by it to write projected coordinates, and it marks each record's flag word as valid or invalid.

name: return_immediately_stub
description: The body is a bare return with no work, so no behaviour is recovered; the code is a stub that only returns.

name: return_immediately_stub
description: The body is a bare return with no work, so no behaviour is recovered; the code is a stub that only returns.

name: resolve_entry_then_dispatch
description: Chooses a table entry from the sign of a flag byte: a negative flag computes the displacement from the parameter block, while a non-negative flag stores a word in a global variable, calls a routine, and calls a fixed external routine when the saved argument is zero. The chosen entry is then called.

name: build_interpolated_edge_table
description: Scans a list of three-word entries for the minimum and maximum of their first two words, then fills a table of records by interpolating between the boundary points with divisions, calling a routine for each step. It returns minus one when the list is empty or a bound check fails.

name: scale_value_then_dispatch
description: Adds a global variable to a 16-bit field from the parameter block; when the sum exceeds 63 it shifts a second field left by the global count, traps on signed overflow, divides, and calls a fixed external routine. It then calls the table entry at offset four.

name: shift_and_pack_word_pair
description: Calls a routine, then shifts two 16-bit registers left by a count from a data register. Each shifted word is returned packed with a sign word taken from its unshifted sign bit, giving a pair of 32-bit results.

name: forward_call_and_return
description: Makes one call to another routine and returns; the decompiled body shows no other work, so the rest of the 30 instructions was not recovered.

name: normalize_and_scale_word
description: Shifts a 16-bit value left by eight bits when it is below 256 and by four more when it is below 4096, then returns it doubled, quadrupled or multiplied by eight, depending on carry tests.

name: compute_two_scaled_ratios
description: Forms sums of products of 16-bit coordinates and their squares, using a global offset and table values, and stores intermediates in a global variable. When the final product is positive it divides two scaled sums to produce a pair of results, calls two routines, and returns the pair; otherwise it returns minus one.

name: dispatch_by_threshold_compare
description: Adds a global variable to a 16-bit field of the parameter record and compares the sum with 64. Below 64 it calls the table entry at the record's offset six; otherwise it calls a routine and dispatches the entry named by its return value, first calling a fixed external routine when the saved flag is zero.

name: dispatch_threshold_with_store
description: Compares a sum of a global variable and a record field with 64 as its neighbour does, and writes a value into a slot at a computed offset before dispatching. The high branch saves the global variable into that slot and restores it, while the low branch writes zero.

name: dispatch_table_entry_from_word
description: Uses the first 16-bit word of the parameter block as the index into the table of routine offsets and calls that entry.

name: store_stack_arg_and_dispatch
description: Stores the 32-bit value passed on the stack into a global variable, then calls the routine selected by the first word of the parameter block.

name: dispatch_table_entry_from_word
description: Uses the first 16-bit word of the parameter block as the index into the table of routine offsets and calls that entry; the code is reachable only through gap decoding, so no further role is visible.

name: check_flag_then_dispatch
description: Reads a 32-bit field at an offset given by the first word of the parameter block. When that field is nonzero it calls a fixed external routine, then calls the table entry selected by the block's second word.

name: call_then_dispatch_first_word
description: Calls a routine, then calls the table entry selected by the word the parameter pointer refers to.

name: call_then_dispatch_first_word
description: Calls a routine, then calls the table entry selected by the word the parameter pointer refers to.

name: store_result_then_dispatch
description: Reads a 16-bit index from the parameter pointer and calls a routine that returns a 32-bit value. It stores that value at a slot computed from the index plus a fixed offset, then calls the table entry selected by the pointer's target.

name: load_record_fields_then_dispatch
description: Copies several 16-bit fields from a record into global variables, storing 64 minus one field and zeros for the others. It then calls a routine chosen through a chain of pointers read from the record.

name: clear_globals_then_dispatch
description: Clears two global variables, then calls the table entry selected by the first word of the parameter block.

name: compute_integer_square_root
description: Runs a fifteen-iteration restoring loop over a 32-bit input, comparing each shifted partial remainder with 16384 and accumulating result bits. It leaves the integer square root in the working word.

name: build_matrix_from_angle_tables
description: Looks up two table values for each of three 16-bit angle fields, shifted and doubled to form table indices. It writes a nine-entry three-by-three matrix of scaled products of those values to the output record.

name: build_matrix_from_angle_registers
description: Computes the same nine-entry three-by-three matrix as its neighbour, but takes the three angle fields directly from data registers and writes the matrix to the output record.

name: return_immediately_stub
description: The body is a bare return with no work, so no behaviour is recovered; the code is a stub that only returns.

name: return_immediately_stub
description: The body is a bare return with no work, so no behaviour is recovered; the code is a stub that only returns.

name: return_immediately_stub
description: The body is a bare return with no work, so no behaviour is recovered; the code is a stub that only returns.

name: copy_five_words_between_slots
description: Copies five 16-bit words from one set of fixed memory locations to five adjacent fixed locations, one word each. The code is reached only through gap decoding, so no caller is visible.

name: multiply_fixed_matrix_by_vector
description: Makes three calls to other routines, then computes three sums of products of fixed memory values, doubling each sum and keeping its high word. It stores the three results in consecutive fixed words.

name: multiply_fixed_matrix_by_vector
description: Makes three calls to other routines, then computes three sums of products of fixed memory values, doubling each sum and keeping its high word. It stores the three results in consecutive fixed words.

name: multiply_matrix_record_by_vector
description: Multiplies a three-by-three matrix held in a record, addressed by one register, by the three-word vector at another register address. Each product sum is doubled and its high word is written to the output record.

name: swap_stored_triplet_buffers
description: Updates a three-word state from fields of a record, after an optional call that adds scaled offsets, then exchanges the current and previous three-word buffers held in fixed memory.

name: build_signed_transform_rows
description: Reads three coordinate words from a record, selects two of them by a flag bit, and multiplies them by a fixed three-by-three matrix. Each result is shifted right by a global count and written together with its negation into the output record.

name: compute_difference_with_sign
description: Loads a 16-bit value from a table indexed by the first parameter word and returns it with its sign word, plus the difference between that value and a second table entry.

name: compute_triangle_plane_dot
description: Takes three point pointers and halves the coordinate differences between them to form two edge vectors. It takes their cross product, scales it down until it fits in 16 bits, and returns its dot product with the third point's offset coordinates; it returns minus one when a containment test fails.

name: compute_plane_dot_from_registers
description: Performs the same containment test and scaled dot product as its neighbour, but takes the three coordinate values from data registers. It returns minus one when the containment test fails.

name: compute_clamped_ratio_fixed
description: Returns a 16-bit fixed-point ratio of two 32-bit inputs. A negative first input returns the negated value from a called routine; otherwise equal inputs return 8192, a first input below the second returns a reciprocal-based quotient, and anything else returns a negated value from a called routine.

name: compute_guarded_ratio_fixed
description: Returns the fixed-point ratio of two 32-bit inputs for a non-negative divisor: a negative second input returns a negated value from a called routine, equal inputs return 8192, and otherwise a reciprocal-based quotient is returned.

name: compute_reciprocal_ratio_fixed
description: Returns the reciprocal-based fixed-point quotient when the first input is below the second. Otherwise it returns a negated value from a called routine, or 8192 when the inputs are equal.

name: estimate_quotient_reciprocal
description: Divides the first 32-bit input by the high word of the second, then refines the quotient with a fixed-point reciprocal estimate. It returns the product with its two 16-bit halves recombined into one 32-bit value.

name: walk_list_and_dispatch
description: Walks a linked list whose head pointer is stored at byte offset 110 of the object. For each node it calls one of two routines, chosen by whether the byte at offset 94 is below 10, and follows the node's next pointer.

name: unlink_and_relink_entry
description: Handles a list entry by checking its byte at offset 94. At 10 or above it links the entry to the head of a global list; otherwise it matches the entry's type word against two constants, searches a short table, and when a flag bit is set it unlinks the entry from its doubly linked list and marks it with a sentinel value.

name: insert_entry_at_list_head
description: Calls two routines, then links the entry at the head of a global doubly linked list by setting its back pointer and its successor's back pointer.

name: unlink_list_entry_and_mark
description: Removes an entry from a doubly linked list, sets its flag word to minus one and marks it with a fixed sentinel. It updates the global list head when the entry is not the sentinel address, then calls a routine; if the entry is already the head it only calls a routine.

name: count_linked_list_nodes
description: Sets a global counter to zero and walks a linked list, incrementing the counter for each node until a non-positive link is reached.

name: expire_stale_list_entries
description: Decrements a global slot index, wrapping to 395 when it passes zero, and walks that slot's linked list. For each entry with no flag bits, a nonzero field, and a stored value more than 4799 away from the global counter, it calls a routine and sets a counter field to 1500 for entries whose saved flag is nonzero.

name: find_first_positive_list_node
description: Walks a linked list from a fixed head, following the next pointer at byte offset 102, and skips nodes whose word at offset 110 is not positive. It calls a routine for the first node with a positive value there.

name: reclaim_node_from_pool
description: Takes a node from a global free list and clears its fields, setting two header words. When the free list is empty it searches a fixed linked list for an entry with a flag bit set, calls routines on that entry, and reuses it.

name: link_node_into_indexed_list
description: Stores the 16-bit argument in the node's word at byte offset 82, then links the node at the head of the list selected by that argument through a lookup table, unless it is already the head.

name: unlink_and_invalidate_node
description: Sets the node's word at byte offset 82 to minus one, then unlinks the node from its doubly linked list by joining its predecessor and successor.

name: unlink_and_invalidate_node
description: Sets the node's word at byte offset 82 to minus one, then unlinks the node from its doubly linked list by joining its predecessor and successor, using a node held in a register.

name: unlink_node_from_chain
description: When the byte at offset 106 is positive, sets that byte to minus one and unlinks the node from its successor chain at offset 102, updating the neighbouring link.

name: push_node_onto_chain_head
description: When the node's field at offset 106 is not positive, links the node in front of the current global head and makes it the new head.

name: initialise_node_pool_and_lists
description: Clears a fixed block of 72 words, writes a set of fixed header values, zeroes a second region, and links consecutive records spaced 144 bytes apart into a chain ending with a null link.

name: update_slot_state_if_active
description: When the global index is nonnegative and the first word of a table is not below it, reads a state byte and a field from the selected record, derives a value from them, and calls a routine. It then sets the global index to minus one.

name: load_word_into_global
description: Copies the 16-bit value addressed by the parameter pointer into a global variable.

name: advance_object_state_counter
description: Updates a per-object state counter from the flag bit 16384 in its input. With the flag clear and the counter at zero it stores a status byte and may call a routine for the active object; with the flag set it increments the counter, and when it reaches 16 it stores a state value and calls a routine.

name: set_state_if_slot_matches
description: Compares a stored slot word with a field of the context. On mismatch it writes a fixed state value and returns; on a match it stores the input value and, when the low byte is 15 and a second word matches the context, calls a routine.

name: forward_call_and_return
description: Makes one call to another routine and returns.

name: reload_countdown_and_copy_record
description: Decrements a per-object countdown at byte offset 12. When it reaches zero it reloads it from offset 6, clears a flag bit and calls a routine, then picks a 73-word table record by accumulating record weights until they reach a byte value. It copies that record's 36 long words into an output block and fills some fields from a second table.

name: search_object_list_for_match
description: Compares the object with a table head and, if it is not the head, walks its list from offset 36. It returns minus one when it finds an entry with id 2592, a flagged entry, or the global entry, and zero when the list ends.

name: reload_countdown_and_copy_record
description: Performs the countdown reload, flag clear and table record copy of its neighbour without the countdown check: it reloads the countdown from offset 6, copies the 36 long-word record selected by weights into an output block, and fills fields from a second table.

name: tick_countdown_and_decrement
description: When a global flag is set and the object's field at offset 8 is nonzero, decrements the countdown at offset 12. At zero it calls a routine; if that result is nonzero it resets the countdown to 1, otherwise it decrements the field at offset 8 and calls a routine.

name: tick_timer_and_reinitialise_record
description: Ticks a countdown at byte offset 12 once a global is set. At zero it reloads the countdown from offset 6, and if a shared field is negative it reinitialises the record from a fixed table entry, otherwise it sets state values from a table lookup.

name: initialise_timed_record_state
description: Initialises a record from a fixed table entry: copies several fields, clears others, and sets a state value depending on how a global compares with one, zero or other values, with a fixed value kept in the record's state word.

name: reset_record_timing_fields
description: Sets the record's word at byte offset 30 to 5372, its word at offset 42 to 20, and clears a third field, then zeroes a global variable.

name: store_record_slot_or_reset
description: When the global value is nonnegative, sets the record's word at offset 30 to 5372, stores the global value in the long words at offsets 34 and 54, clears two words, and sets the global to 255. Otherwise it sets offset 30 to 5372, offset 42 to 20, clears another word, and zeroes the global.

name: load_table_entry_into_record
description: Sets the record's word at offset 30 to a fixed value and copies a long word from a table indexed by the global variable into the record's long words at offsets 34 and 54. It clears two words and sets bit 128 in the global variable.

name: mark_records_matching_mask
description: Scans twelve groups of table entries and, for each nonzero entry, follows the indexed record list. Where a record's flag word has the input mask bit set and its other field is nonzero and unequal, it sets the lowest bit of that record's flag word.

name: dispatch_matching_list_records
description: Compares the global's group bits with each record in a fixed array. Where a record's mask bit is set and its byte at offset 35 is zero, it calls a routine chosen through a record-indexed table or a default routine, then walks each record's secondary list and calls a routine for entries with active flags.

name: compute_record_flag_state
description: When the input index is nonnegative, looks up the matching record and derives a flag from its bit 16384. It calls routines and sets global status values according to their results.

name: test_candidate_offset_range
description: Checks that the offsets of a candidate position fit in 16 bits relative to a record's fields, then calls routines to compute a scaled offset and tests its sign. When the test passes it saves a nine-word buffer, recomputes a shifted value, and restores the buffer.

name: load_long_into_global
description: Copies the long word addressed by the parameter pointer into a global variable.

name: lookup_or_insert_slot_key
description: Searches a small table of slot keys for a value built from the first parameter word and a record index. When the key is absent it inserts it at the front, shifting older entries, then either updates the record and calls routines, or returns a doubled parameter word.

name: restore_saved_buffer_after_call
description: Returns when the global exceeds 4. Otherwise it adds fixed offsets to the global, calls a routine, removes the offsets, and restores a nine-word buffer that was saved to fixed memory.

name: scan_flags_return_scaled_word
description: Scans a list of indices for one whose flag byte is zero. If none is found it returns twice the first word; if one is found it calls routines and returns their result, or zero when the parameter is null.

name: compute_scaled_offset_pair
description: Adds a record field to a 16-bit input and returns a flag pair when the sum is negative. Otherwise it computes a scaled bound from a global variable and, if the first absolute offset fits, returns the second offset instead, together with the bound.

name: compute_scaled_offset_pair
description: Works like its neighbour but takes the base and bound inputs from data registers instead of a record field, returning the same flag pair or offset pair.

name: compute_scaled_bound_pair
description: Computes the same kind of scaled bound from a global variable and a data-register input, returning an offset pair. It has no negative-sum flag return.

name: update_linked_objects_state
description: Walks the object's list from offset 36 and, for each node other than the global one, stores three 16-bit values in its fields. It sets a flag bit when the global is zero, adjusts a value from the node's state word before calling routines, and after the walk may set the global from a table indexed by the byte at offset 94.

name: walk_tree_and_call
description: Returns if the global pointer is null. Otherwise it performs an iterative depth-first walk of a tree whose child and sibling links sit in 16-bit fields at offsets 6 and 4, pushing and popping node records on a stack and calling a routine for each node.

name: clear_two_globals
description: Sets two global variables to zero and returns.

name: insert_sorted_pool_entry
description: Inserts an entry holding a 32-bit key, a zero long word and a pointer into the pool at the next free slot, linking it into a sorted list by key. It then advances the global allocation index.

name: reset_global_after_call
description: Calls a routine, then zeroes a global variable, passing its two 32-bit input registers through unchanged.

name: reset_flagged_list_nodes
description: Walks a linked list from a fixed head and, for each node whose flag word has bit 1024 set, adds bits to its flag word and sets its words at offsets 30, 32 and 26 to fixed values.

name: reset_flagged_nodes_from_node
description: Works like its neighbour but starts from the node in a data register rather than the fixed head, following next pointers at offset 102 while each node's link is positive.

name: add_constant_to_timer_word
description: Adds 800 to the 16-bit word at byte offset 24 of the object and returns.

name: accumulate_fractional_field_shares
description: Adds half of the word at offset 32 to the word at offset 118, and three-eighths of it to the word at offset 116, then calls a routine.

name: compute_flag_shift_adjustment
description: Tests bit 8192 of the word at byte offset 10. When it is set, it calls a routine, takes the high byte of the result, and sets a global variable from eight minus that byte, clamped to zero, plus seven. It returns the masked flag, or the high byte when the bit is set.

name: compute_status_global_flag
description: Writes a series of flag tests into a global variable, but the final value depends only on whether one field equals a fixed value and another field equals 15 or 11: minus one if so, otherwise zero.

name: test_matching_record_offset
description: Returns minus one when two records share the same key, the first record's kind byte is zero, and a value from a called routine is at least 301. Otherwise it returns zero.

name: scan_list_for_threshold_gap
description: Scans a list of 19-word entries selected by a table index. For entries with a nonzero value and passing flag checks it compares a table value, and returns the accumulated high word minus the entry's word at byte offset 12 when the comparison passes; otherwise it calls a routine for matching entries.

name: process_nearby_list_nodes
description: Walks the object's list from offset 36 and, for each node with a nonzero word at offset 16 and no bits from mask 68 set, computes the squared distance from a reference point. When the distance passes a ratio test against a table value and the node's byte at offset 94 allows it, it calls a routine.

name: lookup_scaled_table_entry
description: Derives a table index from the word at offset 32 of the object: negative values map to zero, otherwise the value is shifted right by five, capped at 15 and doubled. It loads the table word at that index into a global variable.

name: lookup_scaled_table_entry
description: Takes the 16-bit input, shifts it right by five, caps the result at 15, doubles it, and loads the matching table word into a global variable.

name: fetch_table_pair_with_sign
description: Loads two 16-bit values from a table selected through the record's pointer at offset 12. When the record is the global one it toggles a global flag, and when that flag becomes zero it negates the first value; it returns the pair.

name: dispatch_indexed_entry_when_large
description: When the global flag is nonzero and the global index exceeds 512, calls the routine at that table entry and returns its result. Otherwise it calls a routine and returns its two inputs unchanged.

name: set_mask_and_call_routine
description: ORs the input with 254. When a global flag is nonzero it calls a routine and returns the masked value; when the flag equals two it may call further routines before returning the masked value.

name: forward_call_passing_registers
description: Makes one call to another routine and returns its two 32-bit input registers unchanged.

name: activate_pooled_record_slot
description: When the global flag is zero, picks a slot from a four-entry table with wrap-around. If the slot's record has state byte 2 it marks the slot free, copies a nine-word buffer, fills the record's position words from it scaled by 160, sets fixed size and limit values, then calls routines.

name: activate_pooled_slot_and_return
description: Performs the same slot activation as its neighbour, but returns a value from the chosen table entry, or the value derived from the input when the slot is not in state 2.

name: return_input_after_optional_call
description: Returns its input value, after calling a routine when a global flag is zero. Further branches may return the result of a routine instead.

name: forward_call_and_return
description: Makes one call to another routine and returns.

name: set_flag_then_call_routines
description: Sets a global variable to 1, then calls a routine that returns a 16-bit value and calls another routine, returning both values as a pair.

name: select_flag_then_call_routines
description: Checks bit 1 of the record's flag word. When it is clear it calls two routines and returns their values; when it is set it sets a global flag to 255 if it was zero, otherwise to 1, and calls a routine.

name: toggle_flag_then_call_routines
description: If a global flag is zero it sets it to 255, otherwise to 1, then calls a routine and returns its 16-bit result along with another call's value.

name: initialise_projected_record_state
description: Copies a record's position words, offset by three values, into an output record and scales three table values by 160. When a record flag is set it derives a clamped ratio from the position difference to a reference point, zeroing it beyond a threshold. It then writes fixed size, limit and index values, selects a value from a table by a clamped byte, and calls routines.

name: initialise_projected_record_state
description: Performs the same record initialisation as its neighbour, but first clears a global variable and does not check the reference record; it copies position, scales table values by 160, and calls routines.

name: initialise_projected_record_state
description: Performs the same record initialisation as its neighbour, taking the position offsets from the global variable and data registers, then writes fixed size, limit and index values and calls routines.

name: increment_clamped_global
description: Adds one to a global variable and clamps the result to a maximum of 9.

name: decrement_clamped_global
description: Subtracts one from a global variable and clamps the result to a minimum of 4.

name: subtract_global_clamped_low
description: Subtracts a global variable from the word at byte offset 22 and clamps the result to a minimum of minus 16384.

name: add_global_clamped_high
description: Adds a global variable to the word at byte offset 22 and clamps the result to a maximum of 16384.

name: accumulate_global_into_field
description: Adds a global variable to the word at byte offset 24 of the object.

name: subtract_global_from_field
description: Subtracts a global variable from the word at byte offset 24 of the object.

name: dispatch_bit_flags_for_record
description: Looks up a record through a fixed table indexed by a global variable. When the record's word at offset 30 is nonzero it stores the index at byte offset 66 and clears the globals; otherwise it reads a bit mask from a second table and calls routines for each set bit before clearing the globals.

name: accumulate_capped_at_global
description: Adds a global variable to the word at byte offset 26 and caps the result at the global value.

name: subtract_global_with_floor
description: When bit 2 of a global flag is set, it derives the global from the sign of the word at offset 26. It then subtracts the global from that word, keeping the result at or above a floor set by the global.

name: decrease_field_with_floor
description: Subtracts 400 from the word at byte offset 118 and clamps the result to a minimum of minus 16000.

name: increase_field_with_ceiling
description: Adds 400 to the word at byte offset 118 and clamps the result to a maximum of 16000.

name: accumulate_field_to_ceiling
description: When bit 4 of a global flag is set it derives the global from the sign of the word at offset 28. It then adds the global to that word and caps the result at 4096, or at zero when the global is nonzero.

name: decrease_field_to_floor
description: When bit 8 of a global flag is set it derives the global from the sign of the word at offset 28, then subtracts the global from that word. The result is kept at or above minus 4096 when the global is zero, or at zero otherwise.

name: snapshot_position_when_idle
description: When the word at byte offset 26 is zero, clears a global variable, copies the three position words at offsets 14, 16 and 18 into words at offsets 84, 86 and 88, and calls a routine.

name: snapshot_position_when_idle
description: Performs the same position snapshot as its neighbour, without the final return path, copying the three position words into the record and calling a routine when the word at offset 26 is zero.

name: store_input_and_scaled_product
description: Stores the 16-bit input in a global variable and in the word at offset 16 as the input minus 78. It then sets the global to the product of the input and the previous global, shifted right by four.

name: advance_state_by_global_branches
description: Branches on the global value: a small nonzero value is shifted and passed to a routine, a zero value starts a new state when a field and a flag are clear, and larger values set a flag, record the value at offset 16, or reduce it by a scaled amount and call routines.

name: scale_global_by_magnitude
description: Computes the global variable minus a shifted copy of itself, where the shift is 0 to 3 depending on whether the value exceeds 60 or 90. The result is stored as zero when the shifted value overflows.

name: update_object_state_machine
description: Processes an object's state from a global countdown and flag bits. For nonzero globals it returns low status bits or a list entry; otherwise it copies position words into a saved slot, sets state bits from the global, calls a sequence of routines, and returns the status value.

name: move_field_toward_zero
description: When the global is zero, a status bit is clear and the global's low bits meet a condition, it adds the global to a negative word at offset 26 or subtracts it from a positive one. The word is set to zero if the update would cross zero.

name: move_second_field_toward_zero
description: Works like its neighbour under a different flag mask: it moves the word at offset 28 toward zero by the global value, setting it to zero if the update would cross zero.

name: test_point_in_boxes_list
description: Tests whether a three-coordinate point lies inside any box in a list held behind the object's pointer, scanning records of 19 words. A hit sets bit 64 of the flag word and stores the matching box pointer at offset 90; a miss clears bit 64. Two specific object types are skipped.

name: mark_object_active_once
description: When bit 32 of the flag word is clear, sets that bit, clears the word at offset 132, and calls a routine unless bit 2048 was already set.

name: mark_object_active_once
description: Performs the same flag-set step as its neighbour, calling a routine only when the bit 2048 flag was clear.

name: relink_object_into_cell_list
description: Places or relinks an object into a spatial list. It tests the object's flag and kind, checks whether the candidate position lies within bounds derived from a referenced record, and when it does not, unlinks the object and inserts it at the head of the list for its cell, computing the new position from that record's offsets.

name: insert_entry_into_cell_head
description: Links the entry at the head of the list stored at offset 36 of the global object and clears its words at offsets 14 and 18.

name: update_object_lifecycle_state
description: Handles an object's state transitions from its flag bits and countdown. It either records position words and clears a state bit, unlinks the object and marks it with a sentinel, or sets a pending bit in another object's flag word and calls routines, then returns the resulting status value.

name: call_routine_if_large_global
description: Takes the absolute value of a global variable and calls a routine when that value shifted right by four is nonzero. The input registers are passed through unchanged.

name: link_nearby_object_pair
description: When neither object has flag mask 18464 set, computes a weighted sum of position differences between the two objects. When the sum is at or below a global threshold and the second object's state word is neither 16 nor 21, it stores the first object's old state, sets state 21 and records the pair; otherwise it clears both link fields.

name: scan_objects_for_collisions
description: Clears the low flag bits of an object and, unless bit 4 is set, looks up a table-driven box size and scans the object list from offset 36. Candidates within the box that pass a distance test get flag bits set and routines called, and bit 4 is set while scanning and cleared afterwards.

name: update_object_state_from_table
description: Looks up a pair from a table indexed by the kind bytes of two objects. When a valid pair is found it updates the second object's state and calls routines; otherwise, if a flag bit is set, it sets or clears status bits, adjusts a countdown from a table, and calls routines. The decompiled listing is cut off before the end, so the tail is not recovered.

name: advance_countdown_state_machine
description: Decrements a per-object countdown by the input value. When it crosses zero it updates the object's state word, sets status bits and a timed value from a table, and calls routines; for the fixed sentinel object it returns the input unchanged.

name: walk_list_calling_pairs
description: Walks a linked list whose head is stored at byte offset 110 of the object, calling two routines for each positive node and following its next pointer.

name: call_table_entries_descending
description: When a global flag is zero, calls a routine and then walks a counted table selected by the object's record, calling a routine for each entry from the last index down to zero.

name: select_weighted_record_and_copy
description: Compares a count byte with a threshold, then selects a 73-word record by accumulating weights until they reach a byte value. It copies that record's 36 long words into an output block, derives fields from a table indexed by the object's record, sets a flag bit, and calls routines.

name: set_object_timers_and_flags
description: Sets bit 4 of the object's flag word and a fixed timing word, then derives position words from the object and the input. It sets a size and a value from a table, sets flag bit 32 when it was clear, and calls routines.

name: return_immediately_stub
description: The body is a bare return with no work, so no behaviour is recovered; the code is a stub that only returns.

name: check_value_within_interval
description: Compares a 16-bit input with an interval built from two words of the record at offsets 8 and 10 and returns. Both paths return with no side effects, so the comparison result is not used.

name: repeat_call_until_wrap
description: Loops over a count read from the parameter pointer, calling a routine on each pass and counting passes, and stops early if the pass counter wraps around to zero.

name: check_point_inside_box
description: Tests a three-coordinate point against a six-word box and returns; both paths return with no side effects, so the test result is not used.

name: integrate_object_position
description: Adds the word at offset 28 to the word at offset 24. When the word at offset 26 is nonzero it either adds scaled table offsets to the position words, or, for a flagged object, adds fixed offsets at offsets 34, 36 and 38. Otherwise it integrates the position words with a table value indexed by the negated offset 24.

name: integrate_position_from_registers
description: Adds a table-scaled step to the object's two accumulator words at offsets 74 and 78, then writes the position words at offsets 14, 16 and 18 from the accumulated carries and the input registers.

name: update_object_motion_countdown
description: Adds four to the word at offset 132, capped at 240, then compares a sum with a limit from a table indexed by the object's record. When the sum exceeds the limit it updates the object's state and calls routines. It also sets the word at offset 26 to the low five bits of a field plus 15, negated when the input is negative.

name: call_two_routines_in_sequence
description: Calls two routines in sequence and returns.

name: tick_flag_timer_and_clear
description: Clears flag bit 4096 and the word at offset 122 when the global flag is zero or the object's flag conditions fail. When the global is at or below the low bits of the byte at offset 8, it sets the word at offset 122 to 15 and sets flag bit 4096. Otherwise it counts the word at offset 122 down and clears the flag when it reaches zero.

name: update_linked_objects_dispatch_handlers
description: Walks a linked list through the next pointer at offset 102, saving each node's position words into offsets 84, 86 and 88. Nodes with a nonzero handler index at offset 30 are dispatched through a routine table, and other nodes have their flag bits checked before the walk moves on.

name: set_position_from_angle_byte
description: Sets the word at offset 24 to the input multiplied by minus 256, minus 32768. It then derives the position words at offsets 14, 16 and 18 from table values selected by the input's low byte times eight, combined with the two register inputs.

name: advance_timer_and_copy_owner
description: Adds four to a counter at offset 126. While it stays below 255 it stores the counter times 16 at offset 22, copies the owner link from the input object into offset 82, and calls a routine. Otherwise it stores fixed values in globals and at offset 30, and copies the owner link into a global.

name: advance_counter_if_below_limit
description: Adds four to the counter at byte offset 126 and calls a routine when a global is negative or the new counter is below 320.

name: compute_clamped_velocity_term
description: Computes a signed value for a pair of objects from their list links and table positions. It returns fixed clamp values for large differences; otherwise it adds a term limited to plus or minus 400 to the object's word at offset 24 and returns it.

name: adjust_field_toward_target
description: Negates a value returned by a routine, subtracts the object's word at offset 24 from it, and adds the difference to that word. The change is limited to plus or minus 400 for objects with flag bit 4096 and to plus or minus 1024 otherwise.

name: adjust_field_toward_target
description: Performs the same adjustment as its neighbour with identical limits, applied to the object's word at offset 24.

name: adjust_field_toward_target
description: Negates a value returned by a routine, subtracts the object's word at offset 24 from it, and adds the difference to that word. The change is limited to plus or minus 400 for objects with flag bit 4096 and to plus or minus 1024 otherwise.

name: adjust_field_toward_input
description: Subtracts the object's word at offset 24 from the 16-bit input and adds the difference to that word. The change is limited to plus or minus 400 for objects with flag bit 4096 and to plus or minus 1024 otherwise.

name: sync_target_field_for_type
description: Returns the object's type word. For two special types it copies the word at offset 74 from offset 118 when it has changed, and when flag bit 8192 is set it calls a routine, clamps the global to the result, then clears flag bit 4096.

name: clamp_field_step_between_bounds
description: Moves the word at offset 118 toward a target by at most 4096 in either direction, then clamps it between the words at offsets 114 and 116. A second path calls routines when a computed magnitude is below 1001 and a flag mask matches.

name: step_field_toward_negated_offset
description: Computes a step from the negated word at offset 24 minus the input and the word at offset 118, limits that step to plus or minus 4096, adds it to the word at offset 118, and clamps the result between the words at offsets 114 and 116.

name: step_field_toward_negated_offset
description: Performs the same step computation as its neighbour, applied to a value the caller has already placed in the input, then clamps the result between the words at offsets 114 and 116.

name: search_object_list_for_candidate
description: Walks the object's list from offset 36 and returns minus one when it finds a node other than the input that lacks flag bit 64, has a nonzero word at offset 26, and has a type value of at least 41. Otherwise it returns zero.

name: handle_timed_spawn_countdown
description: Counts down the word at offset 120 each call. When it reaches zero for a particular object kind it links a table entry and initialises a new object's fields, including a type word, a timing value of 60 and a state mask, then returns the packed result.

name: set_countdown_to_sixty
description: Sets the word at byte offset 26 of the object to 60 and returns.

name: estimate_distance_between_points
description: Computes the absolute x and y differences between two objects' position words and returns the larger difference plus half of the smaller as an approximate distance.

name: estimate_distance_from_point
description: Computes the same approximate distance as its neighbour, taking the first point from data registers and the second from the object's position words.

name: estimate_magnitude_from_three_terms
description: Takes absolute values of three inputs, sorts them, and returns the largest plus half the middle value plus a quarter of the smallest, an approximation of a vector length.

name: derive_timer_for_matching_kind
description: Clears the word at offset 28. When the input object has the same kind word, it derives a value from a routine's result, clamps it to 60 and stores it at offset 26, and toggles the byte at offset 42 when the magnitude is below 101 and a global mask matches. Otherwise it clears offset 26 and sets offset 28 to 400.

name: reset_timer_and_limit
description: Sets the word at offset 26 to zero and the word at offset 28 to 400.

name: initialise_new_object_fields
description: Zeroes the object's timing words and sets flag bit 512. It places the object from a routine result and the input, then stores a type word, sizes of 10 and 80, a value at offset 38 of at least 20 taken from a table, a flag word of 4, a long word from the input and a state word of 12. It clears several fields, sets the word at offset 30 to 1666, and calls routines.

name: select_state_code_by_value
description: When flag bit 8192 is clear it sets two global codes and returns zero. Otherwise it derives a global code from a routine's high byte, then returns the word at offset 88, setting the global to 39 above 399, 37 above 249, and 35 otherwise.

name: call_two_routines_in_sequence
description: Calls two routines in sequence and returns.

name: spawn_record_batch_loop
description: Loops over a count held in a register. Each pass fills a new record with positions from the input and two routine outputs, sets type words, a size word of 48, a timing word from the input, and a fixed value at offset 30, then calls routines. It returns the input registers.

name: advance_counter_capped_thirty
description: Adds six to the word at offset 36, caps it at 30, and sets the word at offset 26 to 48.

name: call_table_entries_until_zero
description: Walks a zero-terminated table of values at a fixed address, calling a routine for each nonzero entry, and returns zero.

name: dispatch_handler_by_record_index
description: Reads the 16-bit index at the pointer stored at offset 20 of the object, multiplies it by four, and calls the routine at that entry in a routine table.

name: return_immediately_stub
description: The body is a bare return with no work, so no behaviour is recovered; the code is a stub that only returns.

name: set_flag_word_when_clear
description: When the byte at offset 33 of the object is zero, stores one in the 16-bit word addressed by the output pointer.

name: record_state_for_slot
description: When a table entry for the global index is nonzero, calls a routine, then stores the global variable and a fixed bit mask in a linked record's bytes. It stores the 16-bit input in a word and sets a status word to 1 or 8 depending on whether the input exceeds the stored word.

name: search_entries_for_triplet
description: Scans records of twelve bytes from a pointer, comparing three words of each with the three register inputs. It returns when a record matches or when a record's flag word is negative.
